ceiling_directive: Prove the four-channel converse for the broader uniform one-sided-shell class by constructing shell-preserving alternatives for every feasible fixed pair of shell constants, thereby eliminating both reservoir-richness inequalities.
improvement_directive: Replace the two-reservoir lower-bound witness with a construction valid without the lower- and upper-shell-richness inequalities, and extend both the risk converse and honest-length converse to the broader class already covered by the estimator.
critique: The matched equivalences are proved only after imposing the lower- and upper-shell-richness inequalities, numerical restrictions tailored to the bespoke two-reservoir lower-bound witness; on the broader uniform one-sided-shell class, the note proves only upper bounds and coverage. Consequently, the four-channel frontier is settled for a paper-constructed reservoir-rich subclass, not for the general shell model or a published weak-overlap class. The estimator and interval also require the tail exponent, shell constants, and all nuisance-error radii as supplied inputs, while adaptive attainment is left open. The TL;DR and honest-scope sections disclose these restrictions, so there is no stale matched or sharp claim outside the explicitly restricted class.
